option.anglewatcher.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for all Angle Watcher HUD elements.
option.anglewatcher.cameraLimitEnabled.t: Master switch for the camera limit. When on, the camera is held inside any range that has its camera-limit flag enabled — no snapping, the view just cannot cross the boundary. Toggle in game with its keybind.
option.anglewatcher.headingCameraLimitEn: Per-tape switch for the camera limit on the heading (yaw) tape. Toggle the individual yaw ranges with the Yaw Range 1–10 keybinds.
option.anglewatcher.pitchCameraLimitEnab: Per-tape switch for the camera limit on the pitch tape. Toggle the individual pitch ranges with the Pitch Range 1–10 keybinds.
option.anglewatcher.editor.instructions: Drag to move • drag edge/corner handles to resize • click Anchor to cycle • R pin mode • arrows nudge • Ctrl+Z undo • Ctrl+Y redo
option.anglewatcher.editor.status_idle: Click a tape to drag it; grab a square handle to resize.
option.anglewatcher.editor.status_pin: Pin mode — click the tape to add a pin at that angle • Shift+click a pin to remove it • R to exit.
option.anglewatcher.tape.anchor.tooltip: Screen corner/edge the tape is pinned to. Offsets are applied relative to it.
option.anglewatcher.tape.width.tooltip: Tape width in pixels. Also adjustable by resizing in the HUD editor.
option.anglewatcher.tape.height.tooltip: Tape height in pixels; text and ticks scale with it. Also adjustable in the HUD editor.
option.anglewatcher.tape.centerMarkerCol: Color of the center marker line (the current-angle indicator), including alpha.
option.anglewatcher.tape.centerMarkerWid: Thickness of the center marker line in pixels.
option.anglewatcher.tape.hideWithGui.too: Hides this tape while a chat, inventory or other screen is open.
option.anglewatcher.tape.tickInterval.to: Degrees between major ticks (5–90). Minor ticks are a third of it.
option.anglewatcher.tape.readoutFormat.t: Simple rounds to whole degrees, Precise keeps one decimal, Decimal always shows a signed three-digit yaw (e.g. +037°).
option.anglewatcher.pin.name: Name
option.anglewatcher.tape.alertSound.tool: Vanilla sound played while the current angle is inside an enabled range of this tape.
option.anglewatcher.tape.alertCooldown.t: Minimum time between alert sounds for this tape.
option.anglewatcher.ranges.desc: Angle ranges are drawn as colored bands on the tape using vanilla yaw (-180° = North, -90° = East, 0° = South, +90° = West; pitch: -90° = up, +90° = down). Wrap-around ranges like 150 → -150 are supported. Use Add / Remove below to manage them (up to 10 per tape).
option.anglewatcher.ranges.max: Maximum of %s ranges reached — remove one to add another.
option.anglewatcher.range.name: Name
option.anglewatcher.range.cameraLimit.to: While the view is inside this range, the camera cannot leave it (no snapping — it just holds at the boundary). Needs the Range Camera Limit master switch in the General tab or its keybind. Each range can also be toggled with its Yaw Range / Pitch Range 1–10 keybind.
option.anglewatcher.range.color.tooltip: Hex color with alpha channel, e.g. 80FFAA00. The alpha byte controls band transparency.
